notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
-More air control while jumping
-More hangtime to help with javelin accuracy
-Faster sword swing/javelin throw
-Music no longer stops on Cliff level
-Fixed rendering issue creating random lines
-Title/Game menu now has controller support

notes.title: Peril now supports multiple languages!
notes.notes:
Languages supported: Arabic, Chinese, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, and Thai.

To access a different language, click the world globe at the title screen and choose your language.
